name: Roasted Sole with Honey Lemon Broccoli & Almond-Raisin Couscous Pilaf

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 220°C (425°F). Position racks in the upper, center, and lower thirds of the oven.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
3 crowns broccoli
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and grate carrots; place in a medium saucepan.
Add broth to the pan with the carrot, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once boiling, remove broth from the heat, add couscous and garlic powder, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups whole wheat couscous
1 ½ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Divide between two baking sheet pans, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets on lower racks of the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until broccoli is lightly charred and fork-tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
While the broccoli is roasting, place spices in a small bowl and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the fish dry with paper towels and place on a large baking sheet; season with spice mix on both sides and drizzle with oil. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg sole fillets
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet on upper rack of the oven and roast fish until flakey and cooked through, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice lemons into the reserved bowl; add honey and oil. Whisk to combine the honey-lemon sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp honey
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: When the broccoli is done, drizzle the honey-lemon sauce over top and toss to coat.
Fluff couscous with a fork, then add almonds and raisins; gently stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup almonds, sliced
¾ cup raisins

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide fish, couscous, and broccoli between plates. Enjoy!
